name: AMS
description: Filament trays, active slot, temperature, humidity and drying status. Selects the integrated AMS 3H or the only reported unit automatically, and uses index 1 for classic multi-AMS layouts. Use ?ams=N to choose a telemetry array entry.

ams.description: Optional index in print.ams.ams, starting at 0. Without it the widget chooses the integrated AMS 3H, index 1 if present, or index 0.

bindings.label: AMS unit object
bindings.hint: Telemetry paths use array positions, e.g. $.print.ams.ams[0] for the first reported unit. Available units depend on the printer and firmware.
